## p120 / p123 - Three-part instruction to Feigenhaus

**Sources on this page:** p123 A2, p123 A3.

**Related source pages:** [p120 B1](120.md#source-p120-b1), [p122 D suffix](122.md#source-p122-d-suffix).

<a id="edition-cases-naval-p120-p123-p120--p123---three-part-instruction-to-feigenhaus"></a>


[Source records](../experiments/corpus_readings/selected_sources.json)

**Records:** p120 B1, the repeated suffix p122 D, and p123 A2-A3.
**Result:** an assembled three-part message under the published Nov4-6 key.
The 461-position reading below is conditional on the repairs in the table:
five valid-coordinate substitutions, nineteen erasure fills and one deletion.
The names and unusual expressions remain literal; their intended referents
have not been established.

**Prior body reading:** George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker
already describe the three-part Feigenhaus/Herkules message in §6.5 of
[*Deciphering ADFGVX messages from the Eastern Front of World War I*](https://doi.org/10.1080/01611194.2016.1169461),
printed p24 / author-PDF page 25. The present contribution by **icekylinx and
GPT-6 Astra Pro** is the source-level edition, exact repair accounting and
identification of the p122 D repeated suffix. This includes the inherited
prior body of that suffix; it is not a first decipherment of the message.

<a id="edition-cases-naval-p120-p123-most-likely-reading"></a>

### Most likely reading

**Readable German:**

> Feigenhaus, Konstantinopel. Sechshundertsiebzehn. Beichtvater
> zweihundertdreiundneunzig. Nachdem Diktator Anweisung gegeben,
> Notschreie in Andreas nicht vorzunehmen, haben wir uns nochmals mit
> Herkules in Verbindung gesetzt.
>
> Herkules ablehnt Verantwortung fuer neue Notschreie. Infolgedessen
> koennen wir auf keinen Fall neue Notschreie in Andreas vornehmen.
>
> Sie wollen deshalb unseren Anweisungen entsprechend sich verhalten.
> Drahtet, was ihr in Anbetracht veraenderter politischer Lage nunmehr
> zu tun gedenkt. Reichsversorgung.

**Meaning:** The sender reports renewed contact with Herkules after Diktator
instructed that no further *Notschreie* be undertaken in Andreas. Herkules
declines responsibility, so the prohibition stands. The recipient is to follow
these instructions and telegraph the action now intended in view of the
changed political situation. The opening names Feigenhaus in Constantinople
and the references 617 and 293, written out as words in the ciphertext.

*Notschreie* literally means cries for help. Together with Feigenhaus,
Beichtvater, Diktator, Andreas, Herkules and Reichsversorgung, it may belong
to a special vocabulary. This edition does not substitute guessed people,
places, institutions or operations for these terms. The irregular telegram
word order and the shift from *Sie* to *ihr* are retained. Word spacing,
punctuation and capitalization are editorial.

### Source support

| [p120 B1](../sources/excerpts/other_p120_B1.png) | 394 slots; all 197 raw positions fixed | One coordinate substitution: raw `ANWEISYNG` becomes `ANWEISUNG`. |
| [p123 A2](../sources/excerpts/other_p123_A2.png) | 232 slots; 97/116 raw positions fixed | Fill 18 printed dashes and one unreadable glyph; change two valid coordinates. |
| [p123 A3](../sources/excerpts/other_p123_A3.png) | 297 printed slots against the declared 296 | Delete one of two adjacent `A` coordinates, then make two substitutions for `ANBETRACHT` and `LAGE`. |

The [p122 D intercept](../sources/excerpts/other_p122_D_suffix.png) is an
**exact 164-coordinate suffix** of p120 B1, starting at zero-based source
index 230. It independently confirms that part of the transmitted stream.
It is not decrypted as a separate short message: changing the transposition
frame to 164 would change the column boundaries.

For part 3, the source visibly prints the eleven-coordinate sequence
`VAAXX VXXAVA`. Deleting source index **211 or 212** gives the same repaired
stream. Among all 297 one-coordinate deletions, these are the only two
minimizers for the **stated candidate**, each requiring two further
valid-coordinate substitutions. This candidate-specific check does not
prove that every possible German reading has been considered.

<a id="edition-cases-naval-p120-p123-assembly-dates-and-credit"></a>

### Assembly, dates and credit

The source labels the parts `1 TL`, `2 TL`, `3 TL` and `3 TEILE`.
The p120 header is `OSM v OUI (8.32 p.m., November 4th); 1956`;
p122 repeats its suffix at 8.33 p.m. with `1056`, and p123 supplies parts 2
and 3 at 8.40 p.m., also with `1056`. The differing four-digit fields are
retained. The route, part labels and exact repeated suffix support the
assembly. No date is changed to fit the period key.

The source is J. Rives Childs, *General Solution of the ADFGVX Cipher
System*, printed pp120, 122-123 / PDF page 123, 125-126 in the
[public scan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_JiNMck7eUvdrOTrH7fsj1Yh44t-VSC6/view).
The complete Nov4-6 key retains its attribution to George Lasry and the
historical/research sources in [the key register](../data/keys.json).
Source assembly, inspection, repair accounting and this edition:
**icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro**. No first historical decipherment priority
is claimed.

```sh
python3 experiments/corpus_readings/verify.py --verify
```

The [certificate](../experiments/corpus_readings/certificates.json)
preserves the unchanged source, every plaintext-to-coordinate map, the exact
suffix match and all deletion trials. Every complete candidate re-encrypts
to its explicitly repaired source.

## p123 B — Question whether a director should depart; name/reference uncertainty retained

**Edition context:** A director-departure inquiry with an unresolved reference.

<a id="edition-cases-people-director-departure-query-a-director-departure-inquiry-with-an-unresolved-reference"></a>



**Source edition and verification: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.**

<a id="source-p123-b"></a>
<a id="edition-cases-people-director-departure-query-p123-b"></a>

### p123 B

Childs p123, PDF page 126; [source crop](../experiments/nov4_radio_and_departure_queries/sources/p123_B.png). Key: unchanged published **Nov4–6**.

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Source transcription — literal received header:**

```text
B) NKJ v LP (04.50 p.m., November 4th)
FUER UKS 1550 (4.11) OBERKOMMANDO BESATZUNGSHEERES VERWALTUNGSSTAB BUKERAST
RICHI-340
```

**Raw output — native 340-slot frame; 160/170 fixed positions:**

```text
ANSCHLIESSENDXTELEGRAMMXROEMISCHX3XDX8511XVOM027XOKTOAERXISTXAUSREISEXDIREKTORSXT4SCHASCHELXUNOERXJETZIGENXVERHMEL4NISSENXRWTRAM?DR?HTAN?WOR?XAUS?AE?TIGX?OEM?SCHX?XD?8698
```

**Edited output — 7 observed-coordinate substitutions and 8 source-mask fills; 168/170 fixed positions:**

```text
ANSCHLIESSENDXTELEGRAMMXROEMISCHX3XDX8511XVOM027XOKTOBERXISTXAUSREISEXDIREKTORSXT4SCHASCHELXUNTERXJETZIGENXVERHAELTNISSENXRATSAMXDRAHTANTWORTXAUSWAERTIGXROEMISCHX?XD?8698
```

</details>

Observed source changes, with zero-based indices: **94 A→G**, **113 V→A**, **114 A→V**, **191 G→X**, **193 X→V**, **206 F→G**, **294 V→X**.

Source-mask fills: **115→F**, **116→X**, **117→A**, **118→V**, **195→F**, **196→A**, **197→A**, **198→A**.

The fixed candidate positions satisfy their exact coordinate pairs. The two unresolved positions remain masked; a complete plaintext re-encryption is not claimed.

**Readable German — complete edited stream, with spacing and punctuation only:**

> Anschliessend Telegramm roemisch 3 D 8511 vom 027 Oktober: ist Ausreise Direktors T4SCHASCHEL unter jetzigen Verhaeltnissen ratsam? Drahtantwort. Auswaertig, roemisch ? D?8698.

**Meaning:** The message follows up an earlier telegram and asks whether the director should travel under current conditions, requesting a wired reply. The baseline surname-like token and date field remain literal; the closing reference has two unresolved positions.

<a id="edition-cases-people-director-departure-query-name-and-reference-alternatives"></a>

### Name and reference alternatives

The complete baseline reading retains the source-derived token **T4SCHASCHEL** and the date field **027**. The closing **ROEMISCH ? D?8698** contains two unresolved positions, which remain in the readable text. The question mark after *ratsam* is editorial punctuation; the two question marks in the closing reference represent the two unresolved decoded positions.

**Conditional interpretation — optional surname proposal:**

The plausible spelling **TISCHASCHEL** would require two additional observed-coordinate changes: source **69 V→X** and **249 X→V**. Its full conditional stream and exact coordinate witness are included separately in the certificate. This is a local name proposal, not an independently established identity, and it does not change the baseline status or its count of fixed positions. No name assignment is propagated to another message.

The two printed five-dash groups remain visible in the source transcription. Eight source masks are filled for ordinary words; the two reference positions remain unresolved. The clear trailing `LP` lies outside the 340 ciphertext slots.
